'''XT-2a Surveyor Droid''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] model in use during the [[Galactic War]]. [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] captain [[Ayor-v9]] used several XT-2a Surveyor Droids for protection of his base in the tunnels of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and considered them to be "his family".<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
XT-2a Surveyor Droids appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Bounty Hunter class mission "Digging His Own Grave" on Hoth.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
